text:
Leah: Morning — async standup. Quick sync on Aurelia Health POC.
Yesterday: ran the demo with their infra team and collected onboarding requirements.
Blockers: they asked if BYOK with HSM is available for Dedicated pilots and whether that changes the SOW. Need a definitive answer for the contract by EOD. :spiral_calendar:
Today: prepping the onboarding doc and contract language, will pause until we confirm infra constraints. @Ethan @sec-bot please chime in.

Ethan: Quick answer — Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS integrations) today. HSM-backed BYOK requires Private/on‑prem deployment or partner HSM flow; it's not available on the vanilla Dedicated offering.
Timeline: if customer insists on HSM BYOK we can schedule a Private pilot (config + legal) — ballpark 2–3 weeks after contract sign + infra provisioning.
I'll draft a short SOW paragraph we can paste into contracts.

Maria: Yesterday: prepared the Nebula Retail sample data package and retention recommendations. Blocker: Aurelia also wants encrypted request logs and a sample retention policy to include in their compliance pack. Do we have a short template?

sec-bot: Security checklist updated: https://redwood-internal/security/kms-hsm-checklist — includes BYOK/HSM decision tree, required legal artifacts (NDA + data processing addendum), and logging/retention template (see section 3).
Also: short SOW snippet you can copy:
```
HSM BYOK: Customer-managed HSMs require Private deployment. Redwood will integrate with customer HSM/KMS per agreed onboarding plan. Additional security review and network configuration required.
```

Jamal: CR ping: #4287 (sales/provisioning) — added the KMS options and SOW draft but waiting on eng/security review for accuracy. Can someone review before I email Aurelia tonight?

Oliver: I'll take the CR and review the SOW language. Note: Dedicated pilot queue is a bit backlogged — current estimate to spin up Dedicated capacity for Aurelia is ~Aug 12 if legal signs by Aug 1. If they need HSM BYOK and opt for Private, that adds provisioning lead time (network & HSM certs).

Leah: Thanks — that's helpful. For the contract, we should include both options with explicit timelines: Dedicated (KMS) — 1 week to onboard; Private (HSM BYOK) — 2–3 weeks. That way legal can pick.

Ethan: Agreed. I'll drop a one-paragraph blurb into the SOW and ping legal. Also tagging @Maria for the retention template so you can attach it to the compliance packet.

Leah: Perfect. No other blockers from me. If legal gets back with green light, I'll send the onboarding calendar invites and the pre-flight checklist to Aurelia. :thumbsup:
